lines.text: I require your treasured guidance once more.

lines.speaker: King Vegeta
lines.text: Just dump him in a hole with his father.

lines.text: And with Broly's magnificent power, we survived the extinction of our race.

lines.text: So does this have *anything* to do with South Galaxy?

lines.text: Cause that's kinda why I'm here.

lines.text: You see, one night while I was discussing The Son of Bardock...

lines.speaker: Paragus

lines.text: This is ridiculous. Stop trying to trigger my son!

lines.text: First of all, Paragus, your seed couldn't compare to my own. And he's a filthy half-ling.

lines.text: And second, I couldn't care *less* about any South Galaxies, or lack thereof.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: So, if you're done wasting everyone's time... Grab your friends, grab your shit, AND GO HOME, KAKAROT!

lines.text: When I woke up this morning for a gay wedding,

lines.speaker: Lanipator
lines.text: Love ya, and catch you later.

segments.title: That's Ten Fours, By the Way
segments.quote: I learned how to count up to 40 because of that! That's ten fours, by the way.

segments.title: KING Vegeta
segments.quote: Or should I say... KING... Vegeta. — Never in my life have I needed something so much and never known until I received it.

segments.title: All Hail Princess Trunks
segments.quote: Hello, Princess Trunks. — I'm not a--! — As my first decree, you shall ONLY call her Princess Trunks!

segments.title: Our Talks Are Nice
segments.quote: Did you destroy South Galaxy? — There's a South Galaxy? — Forget you heard that. — No. — Our talks are nice.

segments.title: Who's This Scrawny Puke?
segments.quote: I'm a foot and a half taller than you, but, whatever... — Your hair looks like lavender, but smells like strawberries...

segments.title: It's Pronounced Dah-Di
segments.quote: Oogh, oh God, *daddy*! — Uh, no! That's my name. It's actually pronounced: "Dah-Di".

segments.title: What Am I, the Space Pope?!
segments.quote: You promised me a kingdom - but I have no subjects, no infrastructure, and a throne made of wood! What am I, the Space Pope?!

segments.title: Good Point, Broly!
segments.quote: What is your power level? — Uh, dunno. Pretty big, though. — Mine too...

segments.title: Stab the Baby
segments.quote: Stab the baby. — SOMEONE FETCH ME A BETTER DAGGER SO I MAY PROPERLY STAB THIS BABY!

segments.title: KAKAROOOOOOOT!!
segments.quote: KAKAROT, KAKAROT-- — KAKAROOOOOOOT!! — See, he's slow, and he gets it. — I suggest we all run.

segments.title: Because It's LEGENDARY
segments.quote: But why is it kinda... green? — Because it's LEGENDARY.

segments.title: What Is a King to a God?
segments.quote: What is a king to a god? — And what is a god... TO A NONBELIEVER?! — Do you believe now? — Uh-huh. So cool...

segments.title: Hug.
segments.quote: Broly! Be a good boy! Show your daddy the love he has shown you...! — Hug. — Oh, nononononono--!

segments.title: SAY MY NAME
segments.quote: Hey! BROLY! SAY MY NAME! — KA…KAA…ROOOOOOOOOTTT!!!! — Victory for Gok—!
